_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score at the upper edge of Anxiety (46) and a 0% historical 12h move rate in this coil, the base rate demands HOLD — no named breaker has fired and both brains confirm compression without commitment.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call HOLD with a sideways regime read; the split is confidence level and how much weight to give the August analog vs live no-edge factors, not the directional call itself.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks below 38 with VIX spike >75 and btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d rising (risk-off resolution) OR breaks above 54 with funding >60 and etf_flows >55 (risk-on resolution).
